subject: Aging hearts lose ER-mitochondria contact, starving autophagy of a key lipid
script: From Agewell Brief: Aging hearts lose ER-mitochondria contact, starving autophagy of a key lipid. New research in mice shows that age-related loss of ER-mitochondrial contacts reduces mitochondrial PE synthesis, impairing autophagosome formation and causing giant dysfunctional mitochondria to accumulate. Boosting PISD activity via LACTB inhibition may restore mitochondrial quality control. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
